propositions: The idempotency oracle patches _now_iso only on binding_store_mod, but RP-02 S2 T2 moved clear_absent and sibling operations to binding_lifecycle, which resolves its own _now_iso, so the patch no longer reaches those moved operations.

The integration test still passes because the no-churn contract means the clock is never consulted on a healthy pass, but its mutation-detection coverage narrowed and would miss a regression that made clear_absent stamp updated_at unconditionally.
The unit-tier contract for clear_absent is already pinned in test_binding_lifecycle.py::test_clear_absent_does_not_dirty_an_entry_with_no_absence, containing the risk.
The idempotency test must patch _now_iso on both binding_store_mod and binding_lifecycle to restore original blast radius and re-enable integration-tier mutation detection.
